responsibility: Defines a mutable graph data structure with per-node and per-edge payloads, storing edges in central arrays threaded into incoming and outgoing adjacency lists, and provides construction, adjacency iteration, and depth-first/postorder traversal utilities over that representation.
same_name_distinction: Within the `mod.rs` set, this file is the concrete mutable graph storage with node and edge payloads plus threaded incoming/outgoing adjacency lists; unlike `graph/vec_graph` it is mutation- and payload-oriented, and unlike `graph/iterate` or `graph/scc` it is not an analysis layer.
